**Cron Job Details:**

| Field | Value | Meaning |
|-------|-------|---------|
| Minute | `0` | At minute 0 |
| Hour | `0` | At hour 0 (midnight) |
| Day of Month | `*` | Every day of month |
| Month | `*` | Every month |
| Day of Week | `0` | Sunday (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, etc.) |

**Schedule:** Every Sunday at 00:00 (midnight)

To view all scheduled cron jobs:
